signal.name: Gemini Audio Authenticity
signal.summary: The audio features a natural-sounding female singing voice with appropriate cadence, clear pronunciation, and logically placed breathing sounds. There are no detectable AI-specific artifacts such as robotic transitions, spectral anomalies, or unnatural vocal textures. The overall vocal performance and production quality strongly suggest authentic human singing.
signal.what_checked: Gemini listened for synthetic speech, cloned-voice artifacts, unnatural cadence, missing breathing, and generated-audio production patterns.
signal.what_found: The audio features a natural-sounding female singing voice with appropriate cadence, clear pronunciation, and logically placed breathing sounds. There are no detectable AI-specific artifacts such as robotic transitions, spectral anomalies, or unnatural vocal textures. The overall vocal performance and production quality strongly suggest authentic human singing.
signal.why_it_matters: When the dedicated wav2vec2 detector is missing or uncertain, Gemini gives the product a direct semantic audio review instead of stopping at an inconclusive model score.
signal.caveat: Gemini is an expert semantic judge, not a calibrated audio classifier. Treat this as one evidence signal in the trail.
observations: Gemini did not list specific audio anomalies.
